title: Replay history corpus manifest (v1)
description: Index of test/fixtures/history-corpus. Each capture records the provenance shared by a set of histories; each entry is one replay case: a history, the frozen definition set it is replayed against, and the required verdict. test/history_corpus/corpus_manifest.ml enforces this schema plus the file-level rules JSON Schema cannot express: SHA-256 checksums, entry/capture references, negative-control sources, and the absence of orphaned files under histories/.

identifier.description: Stable lowercase identifier for captures, entries and feature tags.

history_path.description: Path relative to the corpus directory.

kind.description: live: exported from a Temporal Server; synthetic: hand-written history (temporal_server_image is "none").

sdk_commit.description: Repository commit the producing workers were built from.

sdk_tree_dirty.description: Whether tracked files differed from sdk_commit when capturing.

core_revision.description: Pinned Temporal Core revision linked by the producing workers.

temporal_server_image.description: Digest-pinned server image for a live capture.

protobuf_export.description: Tool and descriptor identity used to encode the JSON export as protobuf.

source.description: Original fixture location for reused histories.

id.description: Unique case identifier printed by the corpus test.

workflow_type.description: Must equal the replayed InitializeWorkflow type for replays_ok.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ID supplied to the replay worker (not stored in History).

run_id.description: Must equal the replayed run ID for replays_ok.

generation.description: Definition set of the worker that produced the history.

json.description: Human-readable Temporal CLI JSON the protobuf was encoded from.

replay_definitions.description: Name of a definition set in test/history_corpus/corpus_definitions.ml.

negative_control_of.description: Required exactly for nondeterminism entries: the replays_ok entry whose history is reused.
